scientific.integrity: The claim is limited to the all-resolving-set structural criterion and its exact recurrence. Previously known metric-dimension algorithms and minimum values are not presented as new. The exact encoded source date 2015-06-02 is supported by an indexed publication record; another secondary page reports only the coarser month April 2015, which is not converted into an invented day.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite connected chain graphs in canonical twin-class form.
The exhaustive verifier covers order at most 10; the unrestricted theorem is proved symbolically.
The full text of the 2015 chain-graph metric-dimension paper was not obtainable through the lawful open-access routes available during review, leaving a stated residual bibliographic risk.

title: Resolving sets and the resolving polynomial of chain graphs
